headline: NFP DAY 8:30 ET (first under Warsh): cons cluster ~80–90k, AHE +0.3%/+3.5% YoY key. Thu pullback — no ATHs; DJI −0.85% gave back Wed record. Claims 199k beat / continuing miss. VIX 15.15 cheap. COIN already reported Jul 30.
client_frame: **Today is the week's real catalyst: first NFP under Fed Chair Warsh at 8:30 ET.** Setup into the print is a consolidation after Mon–Wed risk-on: no ATHs Thursday — SPX −0.18% to 7,710 (still under Tue close ATH 7,736.52), DJI −0.85% to 53,885 (gave back Wed 54,349 ATH), NDX −0.39% to 29,373 (still −4.2% under June ATH). VIX crushed to 15.15 — too cheap for a Warsh-regime payrolls print. **Labor path into NFP is soft-leaning but not collapse**: ADP +44k miss, ISM Services Employment 47.4 contraction, claims 199k beat but continuing claims missed high, productivity strong / ULC soft (disinflationary). Consensus is messy (70–130k desks; core ~80–90k). **What matters for Warsh**: (1) payrolls vs ~85k cluster; (2) AHE MoM — hot AHE re-opens hike path even on soft jobs; (3) UR tick to 4.3% would reinforce cooling narrative. **Hot jobs + hot AHE** = yields up, Sept hike odds reprice higher, equity multiple compression. **Cool jobs + cool AHE** = bull steepener extends, cyclicals/duration work, VIX crush continues. **Cool jobs + hot AHE** = the ugly stagflation-lite mix Warsh has flagged. **Iran remains a separate oil trap** — deal hopes in the price, tanker traffic still ~75–80% below pre-crisis. **Client**: (1) size risk into 8:30 — do not hold oversized directional into first Warsh NFP with VIX 15; (2) AHE > payrolls headline for rate path; (3) NDX is still a recovery trade not ATH — AMD fade not fully washed; (4) ignore COIN today (already reported Jul 30); (5) Berkshire Sat is weekend color not a trading catalyst.
